name: Declared Verify Attempt (verify-attempt)
description: C02 produce+consume demo: `python -m agent verify-attempt` runs `evidence verify-source` as one declared attempt and applies the live Core representation check; an established atom reports acceptance accepted:true while a refuted one emits no acceptance.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the first route where evidence acceptance can be true: the declared attempt produces real evidence, the live representation check binds it to the emitted candidate, and evaluate_evidence_check reports accepted for the established atom.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/verify_attempt/src/identity.mm (established atom) and src/wrong.mm (refuted atom).
Step 1 runs `python -m agent verify-attempt` and asserts acceptance.accepted, candidate_match, the check record and the candidate descriptor.
Step 2 runs the same route against a refuted atom and asserts no acceptance block, normalized exit_code 1 and no selected_result.
Generate evidence: attempt.log, refuted.log, report.json, refuted_report.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: The acceptance evaluation is representation-level only: its checks_not_performed still names all six duties, while the report-level discharged_checks declares the five a selected run discharges for the produced record.
accepted requires the check record to bind the same candidate the sequence selected and the Core outcome to be valid.
Every step exits the pipe-and-grep form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is verify-attempt-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: verify-attempt: established atom accepted
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_attempt/src/identity.mm --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/attempt.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/attempt.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); a=r['acceptance']; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.verify-attempt-report/v1' and a['accepted'] is True and a['candidate_match'] is True and r['evidence_check']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-check/v1' and r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1' and r['discharged_checks']==['claim_truth','file_identity','freshness','producer_authenticity','semantic_correspondence'], r; print('verify-attempt: accepted true, candidate bound, five checks discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json binds schema mumei.verify-attempt-report/v1 with acceptance.accepted true, candidate_match true, a mumei.verifier-evidence-check/v1 check, a mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1 candidate and discharged_checks == ['claim_truth', 'file_identity', 'freshness', 'producer_authenticity', 'semantic_correspondence'].
steps.verifier_gate: verify-attempt exits 0 and reports acceptance accepted:true for the established atom.

steps.name: verify-attempt: refuted atom emits no acceptance
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_attempt/src/wrong.mm --output {output_dir}/refuted_report.json > {output_dir}/refuted.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/refuted_report.json; cat {output_dir}/refuted.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/refuted_report.json')); assert r.get('acceptance') is None and 'discharged_checks' not in r and r['normalized']['exit_code']==1 and r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None, r; print('verify-attempt: refuted atom exits 1 with no acceptance')"
steps.artifact_contract: refuted_report.json carries no acceptance block or discharged_checks field, normalized exit_code 1 and no selected_result for the refuted atom.
steps.verifier_gate: verify-attempt exits 0 at the route level while the refuted attempt reports no acceptance and no selection.

intro: Step 1: verify-attempt produces real evidence as one declared attempt and evaluates its live representation check...
Step 2: the same route against a refuted atom emits no acceptance block...
narrative.before: Evidence acceptance was always unevaluated: no route closed the produce-plus-representation-check loop inside one declared attempt.
narrative.after: verify-attempt emits the check record and the acceptance evaluation in one report; accepted:true only when the check binds the selected candidate and the Core outcome is valid.

pass.headline: verify-attempt: accepted true, candidate bound
follow_up: The live representation check binds the emitted candidate — acceptance.accepted is the first route-level true verdict.
Step 2: Refuting the same route on a wrong atom...

pass.headline: Refuted atom exits 1, no acceptance
follow_up: No produced evidence means no check and no acceptance — the route stays honest about what it cannot claim.
Demo complete: the C02 produce+consume loop is observable end to end.
